title: Install the mobile app
summary: The mobile app lets you answer families and see new inquiries from your phone.

steps.title: Download the app
steps.body: Search for LeadConnector in the App Store or Google Play and install it.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Use the same email and password you use for Banner Connect. If you have more than one account, choose your school.

steps.title: Turn on notifications
steps.body: Allow notifications when the app asks, so you hear about new messages and inquiries right away.

check: Open Conversations in the app and reply to a message. The reply should show up on your computer too.
